diff_summary: The postal_code address field was renamed to zip_code in the order payload.
The order_date timestamp field was renamed to creation_date by the provider.
The line item unit_price field was renamed to item_price in order item details.
The recipient phone_number field was renamed to contact_phone.
The shipping_method attribute was renamed to carrier_code in order fulfillment details.
The discount_amount deduction was renamed to promo_discount in order totals.
The delivery_instruction field for couriers was renamed to dropoff_note.
The buyer_notes field entered during checkout was renamed to customer_comment.
The package_weight metric was renamed to gross_weight in parcel specifications.
The cancellation_reason explanation was renamed to void_reason.
The physical store_identifier code was renamed to outlet_id.
The fulfillment_status lifecycle state was renamed to dispatch_state.
The shipping_city field is now nested inside shipping_address.city.
The billing_zip field is now nested under billing_address.postal_code.
The tracking_number field was moved into the nested object tracking.number.
The recipient_email contact field was relocated under recipient.email.
The buyer_company organization attribute is now nested within buyer.company_name.
The order_currency code is now located inside the nested object pricing.currency.
The nested field vendor.id was flattened to the top-level property vendor_id.
The destination.country_code field is now flattened into destination_country at the root level.
The nested voucher code promotion.code is now supplied as top-level promo_code.
The schedule.slot_window field has been moved to root level as delivery_slot.
The sender_dept attribute is now nested inside sender.department.
The member.tier_level field is now represented as root-level property loyalty_tier.
The tax_amount field changed from a number to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The item_count field changed from an integer to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The shipping_fee field changed from a number to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The line_item_quantity field changed from an integer to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The discount_percentage field changed from a number to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The subtotal_amount field changed from a number to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The package_count field changed from an integer to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The customs_duty field changed from a number to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The points_applied field changed from an integer to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The insurance_cost field changed from a number to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The estimated_transit_hours field changed from an integer to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The service_fee field changed from a number to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The payment_reference identifier was renamed to transaction_ref.
The credit card attribute card_expiration_month was renamed to expiry_month.
The merchant_account_id parameter was renamed to seller_id in settlement records.
The refund_reason_code attribute was renamed to dispute_code in refund responses.
The card_bin attribute was moved into the nested structure source.card_bin.
The risk_level score category is now nested under fraud_check.risk_level.
The nested routing field bank.routing_identifier is now surfaced as top-level bank_code.
The processing.interchange_fee property was flattened to fee_amount in payout items.
The authorized_amount field changed from a number to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The installments_count field changed from an integer to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The refund_amount field changed from a number to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The risk_score field changed from an integer to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The warehouse_identifier location code was renamed to facility_code.
The stock_level inventory count was renamed to available_quantity.
The inventory replenishment parameter restock_threshold was renamed to reorder_point.
The perishable goods timestamp expiry_date was renamed to expiration_date.
The shelf_section aisle coordinate is now nested within location.shelf_section.
The package_volume measurement is now nested under dimensions.volume_cubic_meters.
The supplier.catalog_number property is now delivered as root attribute supplier_sku.
The nested defect property quality_control.defect_reason is now flattened into quarantine_reason.
The on_hand_units field changed from an integer to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The unit_cost_usd field changed from a number to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The reserved_units field changed from an integer to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
The weight_per_unit_kg field changed from a number to a string; the values are numeric strings that can be safely converted.
